reports.title: Recaps
reports.how: Each game in plain sentences, written only from MFL's numbers: the score and margin, each side's top starter, and what the loser's best lineup (MFL's best lineup from the same roster) would have scored. My game first, then the highest winning score.

cells: Buffalo Bills at New York Jets

Buffalo Bills beat New York Jets 277.03 to 179.98, a margin of 97.05. Buffalo Bills' top starter was Fields, Justin (QB) with 31.80. New York Jets' top starter was Sweat, Josh (DE) with 27.50. New York Jets left 26.05 on the bench; its best lineup, 206.03, would still have lost.

Arizona Cardinals beat Jacksonville Jaguars 281.60 to 270.95, a margin of 10.65. Arizona Cardinals' top starter was Stroud, C.J. (QB) with 37.35. Jacksonville Jaguars' top starter was Mayfield, Baker (QB) with 34.20. Jacksonville Jaguars started its best lineup.

Dallas Cowboys beat Washington Commanders 247.90 to 242.65, a margin of 5.25. Dallas Cowboys' top starter was Jones, Mac (QB) with 28.20. Washington Commanders' top starter was Egbuka, Emeka (WR) with 36.30. Washington Commanders left 19.50 on the bench; its best lineup, 262.15, would have won.

reports.title: Top scorers by position
reports.how: The week's three best starters at each position, in the league's position order. Ties keep name order.

reports.title: Fantasy box score
reports.how: My game, starter by starter: each one's NFL game and fantasy points, and whether MFL's best lineup (the most the same roster could have scored under the league's starter rules) started him; then any bench player it would have started. MFL's stat-by-stat scoring lines are not held, so each line is the player's points.

reports.title: Last 3 weeks
reports.how: Each franchise's result and points in the last three weeks MFL scored, up to the week chosen, then its points and record over those weeks. A week without a game counts its points but no result. Most points first.

reports.title: Fantasy previews
reports.how: Each game's projected totals: the sum of MFL's projections for the starters each side has set. A starter MFL does not project counts zero. My game first.

reports.title: NFL schedule
reports.how: The week's NFL games in kickoff order, with the teams on bye. My players are those on my roster for the week, by their NFL team in MFL's player directory today.

reports.title: Official stat changes
reports.note: No held copy of the weekly results has a scored week yet; changes show once MFL has been read again.
reports.how: MFL corrects stats after games. For each scored week, the app compares the first copy of MFL's weekly results it held with the latest, player by player; a change can flip a result. Weeks MFL scored before the app first read it compare from that first read. Newest week first.
